# HU NOW — The Independent Guide to Hull & East Yorkshire

> HU NOW (https://hunow.co.uk) is the premier independent publication, live events calendar, and culture directory for Kingston upon Hull and East Yorkshire. Covering live music, theatre, local sports, dining, heritage, and community life across postcodes HU1 through HU9 and the surrounding East Riding.

## Core Sections
- [What's On](https://hunow.co.uk/whats-on): Daily listings of live gigs, theatre productions, comedy, art exhibitions, sports matches, and family events.
- [Places Directory](https://hunow.co.uk/places): Curated independent directory of local restaurants, historic taverns, craft beer bars, specialty coffee shops, and cultural venues.
- [Editorial Stories & Guides](https://hunow.co.uk/stories): Curated long-form guides, cultural interviews, neighborhood spotlights, and local recommendations.
- [Offers & Perks](https://hunow.co.uk/offers): Verified discounts, dining deals, and community promotions with independent local businesses.

## Local Sports Teams & Schedules
- [Hull City AFC](https://hunow.co.uk/c/whats-on/hull-city): EFL Championship football fixtures, matchday travel, and venue guides for the MKM Stadium (Walton Street, Hull, HU3 6HU).
- [Hull Kingston Rovers (Hull KR)](https://hunow.co.uk/c/whats-on/hull-kr): Betfred Super League rugby league fixtures at Sewell Group Craven Park (Preston Road, Hull, HU9 5HE).
- [Hull FC](https://hunow.co.uk/c/whats-on/hull-fc): Betfred Super League rugby league fixtures and derby history at the MKM Stadium.
- [Hull Seahawks](https://hunow.co.uk/c/whats-on/hull-seahawks): NIHL National Division ice hockey fixtures, face-off times, and ticketing at Hull Ice Arena (Kingston Street, Hull, HU1 2GQ).
- [Hull Jets](https://hunow.co.uk/c/whats-on/hull-jets): NIHL 1 North ice hockey fixtures at Hull Ice Arena.
- [All Sport Hub](https://hunow.co.uk/c/whats-on/sport): Aggregated sports fixtures, parkruns (East Park, Peter Pan Park, Humber Bridge), 10K races, and community sports.

## Curated Editorial Guides & Verified Answers
- [The Best Sunday Roasts in Hull & East Yorkshire](https://hunow.co.uk/guides/best-sunday-roasts-hull-east-yorkshire): Guide to giant Yorkshire puddings and slow-cooked local beef at The Minerva Hotel, The Lion & Key, and the Michelin-starred Pipe and Glass in South Dalton.
- [Hull Fair Complete Guide (Evergreen)](https://hunow.co.uk/hull-fair): The authoritative ground-truth superhub for Europe's largest travelling fair at Walton Street. 2026 dates (9-17 Oct), daily opening times (2pm-11pm, closed Sundays), ride prices, and parking shuttles.
- [Humber Street Sesh Festival Guide](https://hunow.co.uk/humber-street-sesh): The UK's biggest grassroots independent music festival on Hull Marina & Fruit Market. 200+ bands, 14 stages, wristbands, and lineup guide.
- [Freedom Festival Hull Guide](https://hunow.co.uk/freedom-festival): Hull's premier international arts festival celebrating Sir William Wilberforce. 5 days of world-class street theatre, circus spectacles, and outdoor installations across the city.
- [Hull Christmas Lights Switch-On Guide](https://hunow.co.uk/christmas-lights-switch-on): Official guide to Queen Victoria Square festive switch-on. 50ft tree lighting, fireworks, pantomime cast appearances, and late night shopping.
- [Pride in Hull Guide](https://hunow.co.uk/hull-pride): One of the UK's largest free community Pride events. 50,000+ attendees, city parade from Interchange, main stage pop headliners, and community wellbeing hubs.
- [Guide to Parking at Hull Fair](https://hunow.co.uk/guides/guide-to-parking-at-hull-fair): Essential travel guide. Best parking is Priory Park & Ride (HU4 7DY) with dedicated Stagecoach and East Yorkshire Buses shuttles. Walton Street car park is closed to public parking.
- [Christmas in Hull Guide](https://hunow.co.uk/guides/christmas-in-hull-markets-events-pantoland-guide-2026): Christmas lights switch-on in Queen Victoria Square, Victorian Christmas markets around Hull Minster and Trinity Square, and pantomimes at Hull New Theatre and Hull Truck Theatre.
- [Where to Celebrate New Year's Eve in Hull](https://hunow.co.uk/guides/where-to-celebrate-new-years-eve-in-hull): Waterfront celebrations at Humber Street and Hull Marina, historic Old Town pub crawls, and prime viewpoints for fireworks at Victoria Pier.
- [Bonfire Night & Fireworks in Hull & East Yorkshire](https://hunow.co.uk/guides/bonfire-night-fireworks-displays-in-hull-east-yorkshire): Organized displays at Brantingham Park, Beverley Westwood (free admission), and Craven Park.
- [Dog-Friendly Pubs & Bars in Hull](https://hunow.co.uk/guides/dog-friendly-pubs-hull): Comprehensive guide to dog-friendly drinking spots in Old Town (Minerva, Lion & Key, Sailmakers), Fruit Market (Taphouse), and the Humber Bridge Country Park.
- [The Best Free Things to Do in Hull](https://hunow.co.uk/guides/free-things-to-do-hull): Free admission to Streetlife Museum of Transport, Wilberforce House, Ferens Art Gallery, Seven Seas Fish Trail, and East Park.
- [Rainy Day Activities in Hull with Kids](https://hunow.co.uk/guides/rainy-day-activities-hull-kids): Top indoor family spots including The Deep submarium, Streetlife Museum, public ice skating at Hull Ice Arena, and Rockcity Climbing Centre.
- [Best Vegan & Plant-Based Spots in Hull](https://hunow.co.uk/guides/best-vegan-restaurants-hull): Plant-based dining guide covering Newland Avenue, Trinity Market street food, and independent cafes across the city.

## Real-Time Civic Infrastructure Data
- [Humber Bridge Status](https://hunow.co.uk): Live toll information (£1.50 per car, free for motorcycles, pedestrians, cyclists), speed limits, and high wind vehicle restrictions.
- [River Humber Tides](https://hunow.co.uk): Real-time Environment Agency water level readings at Victoria Pier (Hull Marina entrance).
- [Hull Weather](https://hunow.co.uk): Live temperature, wind speed, gusts, and forecast for Hull and Humber Estuary.

## Full Machine-Readable Knowledge Base
- [Complete Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)](https://hunow.co.uk/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive text dump formatted for LLM context windows, citations, and retrieval engines.
- [XML Sitemap](https://hunow.co.uk/sitemap.xml): Search engine and crawler sitemap covering all canonical URLs.
